text: Buala is a brand of Energy Plus Iberia, S.L. (NIF B13772090), the Spanish company that operates the buala.es website and is registered in the Registro Mercantil de A Coruna. The Buala legal notice names Energy Plus Iberia S.L. as the company behind the services and domain.
short: Buala is a brand of Energy Plus Iberia, S.L. (NIF B13772090), per the Buala legal notice.

source.name: Buala website legal notice (Aviso legal)
source.quote: La empresa que gestiona los servicios y el dominio web es Energy Plus Iberia S.L
